description: The taint model pack. Sources, sinks, passthroughs, sanitizers and effects are DATA: the engine matches callee symbols against these patterns (suffix-segment match, see PatternMatcher) and never hard-codes a rule. Argument-index convention: 0 is the RECEIVER when the callee has one, otherwise the first argument; n is the n-th element of that (receiver,) arguments sequence; -1 is the call's result. Constructor callees render as the class FQN (no <init> suffix). P4 is the first phase that executes this pack, which is why several P0 seed entries carry corrected indexes. P26 §1.3: deserializers name the calls whose PRODUCED OBJECT carries the input's taint on its FIELDS (Jackson readValue/readTree, kotlinx decodeFromString, Gson fromJson) - the boundary that makes a request body reach a sink through a DTO.
name: security-pack-v0
